about: A small search library that finds Chinese text when you type its pinyin, mixed with English.

prs.title: Pinyin search finds 银行, 成都 and other common words
prs.broken: Common words like 银行 (bank) and 成都 (Chengdu) could not be found by typing their pinyin, because the dictionary knew only one way to read some characters.
prs.changed: The second, common reading was added for 12 characters such as 行, 都, 调 and 厦.
prs.matters: People typing pinyin now find the everyday words they are looking for.
